metadata.description: Claude Code mods for watching and checking the agents a session delegates to: agent-shell-watch (live shells, background tasks and runner runs), agent-council (parallel reviewers on your diff) and agent-compact-advisor (when to compact, and what to keep).

plugins.name: agent-shell-watch
plugins.description: Live view of every Bash call, background task and external agent run of the session: elapsed time, output freshness, errors.

plugins.name: agent-council
plugins.description: /council and an auto-review nudge: Codex, Pi, Devin and OpenCodeReview review your diff in parallel; one summary of agreements, disagreements and unique findings.

plugins.name: agent-compact-advisor
plugins.description: Tells you when the session is ready to compact: a score with reasons, a ready /compact suggestion, and a template that keeps goals, decisions and leftovers through any compaction.
